name: field-finance-payouts
objective: Close the field actor's own wallet, ledger, commissions and payout requests through DSH while WLT remains financial truth.
truthOwner: WLT exclusively owns wallet/ledger/commission/payout financial truth; DSH is authenticated/authorized BFF; app-field only renders and requests allowed self actions.

tasks.objective: Close field self wallet/ledger/commission/payout scoping and DSH-to-WLT boundary.
tasks.currentProblem: UI/API paths exist, but same-SHA actor/context isolation, proxy/repository scoping and no-local-truth evidence remain incomplete; Product Truth is DISCOVERY.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace authenticated field self routes through DSH proxy/context to WLT repositories and eliminate any arbitrary actor/context or local financial derivation path.
tasks.targetState: Field sees only WLT-owned own financial truth through DSH with no direct WLT or DSH balance mutation.
tasks.action: Fix WLT/DSH owning layers first, generated/canonical clients next, then field presentation; add cross-actor/context negative tests.
mustNotChange: No field-supplied beneficiary actor or operator context.
No DSH/frontend balance calculation or mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-actor/cross-context reads fail closed without disclosure.
Displayed balances/ledger/commissions match WLT truth without local derivation.
WLT unavailable produces explicit fail-closed/retry state rather than cached false success.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix finance boundary; never restore direct WLT or local balance truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused field finance boundary/isolation commit.

tasks.objective: Close field payout request eligibility/idempotency and permission-scoped operator readback.
tasks.currentProblem: Payout UI exists, but duplicate/payload-drift/insufficient-balance and finance.read operator lookup require retained runtime evidence.
tasks.requiredChange: Verify/correct payout request identity, eligibility, status readback and same-operator-context control-panel lookup.
tasks.targetState: A valid own payout is recorded once; invalid/duplicate/divergent retries are deterministic; authorized finance operator reads matching WLT-backed state.
tasks.action: Add WLT/DSH tests and manual readback using one field actor; retain independent finance-control decision separately.
mustNotChange: No operator read permission becomes money-movement permission.
acceptanceCriteria: Payout cannot exceed current allowed balance/eligibility and duplicate replay cannot duplicate financial effect.
Payload drift under the same idempotency identity is rejected.
finance.read operator lookup matches the field actor and cannot cross trusted context.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix payout ledger/request state; do not manually edit balances to recover.
